funder_says: The council's own data description states that its calls stopped being organised around finansieringsaktiviteter in 2019/2020 and are now organised around soknadstyper published as utlysninger. Our row IS a finansieringsaktivitet -- the ledger code an award was booked under, which is what `extract_nfr.py` reads out of `currentActivity.activity`. The council's calls register lists 51 calls accepting applications today and none of them is this row: the two are different units of record. So this row is not a thing a founder can apply to, whatever money moved through it.

corroboration.note: status.theme == 1 is the register's own 'Sok na'. 51 open calls exist; the corpus holds none of them as a row.

[...] Det er et brudd i tidsserien for soknadstyper i 2019/2020.
basis: the council's own published data description (fetched 2026-08-12, HTTP 200) plus its own calls register

corroboration.note: status.theme == 1 is the register's own 'Sok na'. 51 open calls exist; the corpus holds none of them as a row.

mismatch: yes - the row is a finansieringsaktivitet (ledger code), not an utlysning (the applicable unit)
note: DO NOT SUPPRESS ON THIS ALONE. The verdict is about the UNIT, not about liveness: several of these codes carry live 2026 money (nfr_inno has open calls right now). The fix is to re-key Norway onto the utlysninger that ETL/terms/harvest_nfr_open_calls.py now harvests, and to retire these rows only once that replacement is in place.

funder_says: The council's own data description states that its calls stopped being organised around finansieringsaktiviteter in 2019/2020 and are now organised around soknadstyper published as utlysninger. Our row IS a finansieringsaktivitet -- the ledger code an award was booked under, which is what `extract_nfr.py` reads out of `currentActivity.activity`. The council's calls register lists 51 calls accepting applications today and none of them is this row: the two are different units of record. So this row is not a thing a founder can apply to, whatever money moved through it.
